title: Microsoft Windows bindflt Driver Missing Authentication Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the bindflt.sys driver. A crafted request with an IOCTL of 0x220000 can perform remapping of directories. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
